name: opencode-vision-helper
description: OpenCode-native vision fallback for models without image input

scripts.check: npm run check:style && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.opencode.json --noEmit
scripts.check:style: biome ci src tests scripts opencode package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.opencode.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src tests scripts opencode package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.opencode.json biome.json
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:package
